status: LOCKED. Approved by the client: the maps of the original Napoleon Short (Ep01) and the 1805 campaign map of the 20s POC; matched for 16:9 on 2026-10-27.
change_rule: Any change to this preset, to the fingerprinted drawing code or to the ranges below needs the client's explicit, dated approval (record it in 'approvals').

approvals.what: client: maps of the original Ep01 Short are the locked reference
client: strict consistency with the Ep01 map scenes; save as a reusable locked preset

look.land: sand parchment with paper texture and darker coastal rim
look.sea: navy gradient with three shoreline ripple lines
look.rivers: thin blue straight polylines, italic river names
look.arrows: blue = France, red = enemies; dark outline, travelling light dashes, drawn progressively, stay on the map
look.markers: white dots with dark ring, red dashed encirclement rings, gold battle stars with glow
look.typography: gold tracked kicker + ivory date ticker at the top; ivory bold labels with shadow; legend bars bottom-left
look.image: vignette 0.24, grain 0.008, top and bottom scrims

measured_ranges._how: computed from the map data and camera over each shot (ghm4/map_style.py); relative to the frame's SHORT side

label_rules: point labels: map_label preset (ivory, bold, shadow), 20-29 design units
dated places as ONE label 'PLACE · DATE' (Ep01 convention), never a separate gold or italic line under it
notes: map_label size 20 (ivory); no gold or italic map_note text on land in new maps
labels never clipped, never touching (12 px), never under the subtitles or the legend; a label fades when its place leaves the frame
code_fingerprint_note: SHA-256 of the MapShot drawing code and the colour/typography constants (ghm4.map_style.code_fingerprint). The regression test map_lock fails if it changes. Update it only together with a dated client approval in 'approvals'.

campaign_1805_austerlitz.json.stroke: The approved 20s POC (9:16 Short) ends this map with a fast punch-in toward Austerlitz (camera 7.4 -> 2.0 during the fade-out) as a transition into the painting; arrows reach 38-61 per mille there. Kept as the approved data for that Short, NOT a pattern for documentary maps: new maps must stay inside arrow_stroke_permille (the client called larger arrows oversized on 2026-10-27).
